headline: President Obama created an advisory council to give the White House advice on US business ties with African countries.
what_it_does: This executive order set up the President's Advisory Council on Doing Business in Africa. Based on its title, the council's job is to advise the President on business and trade between the United States and African countries. No summary was provided, so details such as who serves on the council or exactly what it must do are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: US companies doing or seeking business in Africa
who_it_affects.how: They may have input on the council's advice to the President about trade and investment in Africa.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle trade and commerce
who_it_affects.how: They may receive recommendations from the council on US business policy toward Africa.
